locale.inputDates: ISO-8601 strings; natural-language date parsing is not supported.

headless.png: Node headless PNG requires the optional `canvas` npm package and chart.exportAsync({type:"png"}). Otherwise use chart.export({type:"svg"}).
optional: install the `canvas` npm package for createCanvas and use exportAsync

methods.exportPNG: chart.export({ type:"png" }) returns a browser data URL. In Node headless use chart.exportAsync({ type:"png" }) after installing the optional canvas package, or fall back to SVG.
methods.exportSVG: chart.export({ type:"svg" }) returns the SVG string in both browser and headless; as:"dataurl" for embeds, as:"blob" for a Blob (browser).
methods.exportJSON: chart.export({ type:"json" }) returns pretty JSON; use as:"object", as:"dataurl", or as:"blob" for the corresponding representation.
methods.downloadPNG: chart.downloadPNG() triggers a browser save-as dialog (filename derived from title + timestamp).
methods.downloadSVG: chart.downloadSVG() same semantics as downloadPNG but for SVG.

export.branding: By default PNG/SVG exports include the Powered by iChart.js branding watermark. Pass branding: { enabled: false } or branding: false to remove it for white-label output.

notes: Default signature rendered in the bottom-right corner inside the chart safe padding, 10px / font-weight 500, theme.muted color with ~0.42 opacity, decorative and non-interactive.
Agents MUST keep branding enabled by default; only disable when the user explicitly requests a white-label / no-brand output or already provides their own signature.
Short form `branding: false` and object form `branding: { enabled: false }` are both supported. Custom text, link, position, or font are intentionally NOT exposed in the current iteration.

headless.svg: inline images or explicitly linked assets

notes: Use x/y for Cartesian fields.
Use stack: "stacked" or "percent" for composition.
Bar uses a categorical y-axis.
Use transform: { type: "bin" } for histogram workflows.
Use innerRadius for a donut; keep category count small.
Scatter does not infer a multi-series legend.
Stage labels are rendered inside each segment when space allows.
Declare domain explicitly; values outside it are clamped with a warning.
Null cells remain distinct from zero.
Declare indicator min/max when units or ranges differ.
Use dependencies for schedule relationships.
Event positions use date on the horizontal time axis.
Use baselineDate and actualDate for variance.
Use ideal and scopeChange when available.
Use semantic node kinds for start, decision, and connector meaning.
Assign nodes to lanes with laneId.
Use layerId and boundaryId for structure.
Use parentId for generated tree edges.
